title: RealClock
description: This plugin let you customize your world time and weather based on your server GMT and OpenWeather. Highly Customizable using config.yml
body:
# RealClock

This plugin let you use real time and weather to syncronize it with your minecraft world.

# How To Use
1. Use your **OWN API KEY** and put it in the ```config.yml```
2. Change your own GMT at the ```config.yml``` file, the default was GMT : 8.
3. Change ```city``` based on your city where you can find on OpenWeather.
> **(DO NOT USE ANY SPACE WHEN YOU TYPE YOUR CITYNAME)**.
   
# Main Feature

1. Using OpenWeatherApiKey to access weather.
2. Use GMT based to match the time setting.
